title: Mount Tracking Error by Target Region
dataSources: Observing sessions (`astronomy:session`), sky quality (`skyquality:reading`), mount telemetry (`mount:session`), focus metrics (`focus:metric`), observatory roof state (`observatory:roof`), sub-frame results (`astroimage:sub`), and all-sky detections (`allsky:event`).
app: Astronomy telemetry from N.I.N.A., KStars/Ekos, Sky Quality Meters, all-sky cameras, focus routines, roof controllers, and image-rejection logs streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mount:session
| stats avg(rms_arcsec) as avg_rms_arcsec max(rms_arcsec) as max_rms_arcsec by target_region
| sort - avg_rms_arcsec
description: Compares guiding and tracking error across parts of the sky so flexure, balance, or obstruction issues stand out.
value: Some mount problems only appear in certain regions, and this view makes that pattern visible instead of anecdotal.
implementation: Capture guiding RMS with a derived target-region label such as east, west, meridian, or low-altitude quadrants.
visualization: Bar chart of average and peak guiding RMS by target region.
grandmaExplanation: It logs which parts of the sky are hardest for your telescope mount to track smoothly.
